items.title: 8.2 Graphical Method for Approximating Real Roots (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: PDF 236-238 (book p. 234-236): graphical method, its steps, Example 2 (x - cos x = 0) with its table and Figure 8.3, radian-mode Note

blocks.text: Pichhle sabaq mein LRT ne humein yeh bataya ke root kis interval mein hai. Lekin woh yeh nahin batata ke root interval mein theek kahan hai. Ab hum pehla tareeqa seekhte hain jo root ki value ka andaaza deta hai: Graphical Method. Is ka khayal bilkul seedha hai: graph banao aur dekho ke woh \(x\)-axis ko kahan kaatta hai.

Kitab kehti hai: LRT seekhne ke baad hum nonlinear equations ke roots ka andaaza lagane ke liye graphical method istemal kar sakte hain. Yeh method nazar se (visually) dikhata hai ke function \(x\)-axis ko kahan kaatta hai.

Graphical method zyada tar root ko ek ya do decimal places tak nikalne ke liye munasib hai, aur yeh Bisection Method, Regula-Falsi Method aur Newton-Raphson Method jaise numerical methods ke liye shuru ka andaaza (initial estimate) deta hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Sirf ek ya do decimal places hi kyun? Graph aankh se parha jata hai. Graph paper par bhi hum crossing point ko sab se chhote khaane (square) se zyada theek nahin parh sakte, is liye teesra decimal sirf tukka hoga. Isi wajah se graphical method ko shuru ke andaaze ke taur par istemal karte hain, aur 8.3 ke methods phir usay jitne decimals chahiye utna behtar kar dete hain.
LRT yahan kya madad karta hai? Woh batata hai ke kaunsa chhota sa interval draw karna hai. Poora graph banane ki zaroorat nahin; sirf woh hissa banate hain jahan sign badalta hai. Is se waqt bhi bachta hai aur graph bhi bara aur saaf banta hai.

items: Interval of sign change dhoondiye jahan \(f(a) \cdot f(b) < 0\) ho, agar sawal mein diya na gaya ho.
\(y = f(x)\) ka graph \(xy\)-plane par sirf interval of sign change ke andar banaiye.
Dekhiye ke graph \(x\)-axis ko kahan kaatta hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Step 2 amal mein kaise karein:
1. Interval ko 10 barabar hisson mein baantiye, jaise \(x = 0, 0.1, 0.2, \ldots, 1\), aur \(f(x)\) ki table banaiye. Table mein 4 decimal places rakhiye.
2. Woh do saath wale points dhoondiye jahan sign badalta hai; crossing inhi ke beech hai.
3. Doosre decimal ke liye in do points ke beech ghaur se dekhiye (ya 0.01 ke qadmon par dobara table banaiye).
4. Rounding ka yaqeen karne ke liye check kijiye ke \(f(c - 0.005)\) aur \(f(c + 0.005)\) ke sign ulte hain, jahan \(c\) aap ka 2-decimal jawab hai. Phir LRT ke mutabiq root \(]c - 0.005, c + 0.005[\) mein hai, aur yeh poora interval round ho kar \(c\) hi banta hai.

blocks.title: Example 2
blocks.problem: Find a root of the equation \(x - \cos x = 0\) graphically, approximate to two decimal places.
steps:
Diya gaya: equation \(x - \cos x = 0\).
Maloom karna: is ka ek root, do decimal places tak.
Tareeqa: graphical method. \(y = f(x) = x - \cos x\) rakhenge, interval of sign change dhoondenge, us ke andar \(f\) ka graph banayenge, aur dekhenge ke graph \(x\)-axis ko kahan kaatta hai. Yeh equation algebra se hal nahin hoti, is liye yahi tareeqa munasib hai.

Calculator set karna (Fixing Calculator)
Calculator ko do decimal places par fix kijiye (aur radian mode mein rakhiye).
Kyun: jawab do decimal places tak chahiye, aur yahan \(\cos x\) mein \(x\) radians mein hai (neeche wala Note dekhiye). Degree mode mein saari values ghalat aayengi.

Continuity
\[y = f(x) = x - \cos x\]
\[f(c) = \lim_{x \to c}(x - \cos x) \quad \forall c \in \mathbb{R}\]
\[\Rightarrow f \text{ is continuous at every real number.}\]
Kyun: \(x\) aur \(\cos x\) dono har jagah continuous hain, aur do continuous functions ka farq (difference) bhi continuous hota hai. LRT lagane ke liye yeh sharat zaroori hai.

Interval of Sign Change dhoondna
\[f(0) = 0 - \cos 0 = -1 < 0\]
\[f(1) = 1 - \cos(1) = 0.46 > 0\]
Kyun: dono ke sign ulte hain, is liye \([0, 1]\) interval of sign change hai aur LRT ke mutabiq root isi mein hai. (Radian mein \(\cos 1 = 0.5403\).)
Dhyan dein: \(\cos 0 = 1\) hai, zero nahin; isi liye \(f(0) = -1\) aaya.

Graph banana
\[f(0.7) = 0.7 - 0.7648\]
\[= -0.0648 \approx -0.06\]
\[f(0.8) = 0.8 - 0.6967\]
\[= 0.1033 \approx 0.10\]
Kyun: hum \(x = 0.1, 0.2, \ldots, 0.9\) par \(f\) nikalte hain (saari values neeche table mein hain), points plot karte hain aur unhein smooth curve se jor dete hain (Figure 8.3). Sign 0.7 aur 0.8 ke beech badla, to graph \(x\)-axis ko yahin kaatega. Baaqi interval ko ab chhor sakte hain.

Root parhna
Curve \(x\)-axis ko \(x \approx 0.74\) par kaatti hai.
Kyun: \(f(0.7) = -0.06\) aur \(f(0.8) = 0.10\); is chhote se hisse mein curve taqreeban seedhi hai aur 0.16 upar jati hai. Zero tak pahunchne ke liye use 0.06 upar jana hai, yani \(\frac{0.06}{0.16} \approx 0.4\) hissa, to crossing 0.7 se aage taqreeban 0.74 par hai. (Hamari taraf se mazeed check: \(f(0.73) = -0.0152\) aur \(f(0.74) = 0.0015\), yani crossing 0.74 se zara si pehle hai.)

Tasdeeq:
\[f(0.735) = -0.0068 < 0\]
\[f(0.745) = 0.0099 > 0\]
Kyun: LRT ke mutabiq root \(]0.735, 0.745[\) mein hai, aur is interval ka har number round karne par 0.74 hi banta hai. Is liye 0.74 do decimal places tak bilkul sahi hai. (Computer se root 0.7391 aata hai.)

blocks.caption: Values of \(f(x) = x - \cos x\) inside \([0, 1]\) (the table printed in Example 2, corrected)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki table mein \(f(0.1) = -0.89\) chhapa hai. Asal mein \(f(0.1) = 0.1 - \cos 0.1 = 0.1 - 0.9950 = -0.8950\) hai, jo do decimal places tak \(-0.90\) banta hai. Upar ki table mein sahi value \(-0.90\) likhi hai. Baaqi saari values durust hain, aur root 0.74 par is ka koi asar nahin.

blocks.alt: Graph of y = x minus cos x on the interval from 0 to 1, plotted through the points x = 0, 0.1, ..., 1 on a grid. The curve rises from (0, -1) to (1, 0.46) and crosses the x-axis at about x = 0.74. A dashed vertical line marks x = 1.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.3: \(y = x - \cos x\) on \([0, 1]\) crosses the x-axis at \(x \approx 0.74\) (original drawing after the textbook's figure)

blocks.text: Ab kitab ke mutabiq \(y = x - \cos x\) ka graph interval \([0, 1]\) par banaiye, jaisa Figure 8.3 mein hai. Figure se saaf nazar aata hai ke curve \(x\)-axis ko \(x \approx 0.74\) par kaat rahi hai. Is liye do decimal places tak matloob (required) root \(x \approx 0.74\) hai.

blocks.title: Note
blocks.text: Trigonometric equations ke saath hisaab karte waqt calculator ko hamesha radian mode mein rakhiye.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Radian mode hi kyun? Calculus mein \(\sin x\) aur \(\cos x\) mein \(x\) hamesha radians mein hota hai. Degree mode mein calculator \(\cos 1\) ko \(\cos 1^{\circ} = 0.9998\) samajhta hai, jab ke sahi \(\cos 1 = 0.5403\) hai. Is tarah \(f(1)\) 0.46 ke bajaye 0.0002 aa jayega, aur table ki har value ghalat ho jayegi. Is liye sawal shuru karne se pehle calculator ki screen par "R" ya "Rad" zaroor dekh lijiye.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
\(f(x) = x - \cos x\) ke liye \(f(0.5)\) kitna hai, aur kya root 0.5 se pehle ho sakta hai?
Jawab: \(f(0.5) = 0.5 - 0.8776 = -0.3776\), jo abhi bhi negative hai. Kyun ke \(f\) is interval mein barhta hi ja raha hai aur \(f(0.5)\) negative hai, is liye 0.5 tak koi crossing nahin; root 0.5 ke baad hai, jaisa graph mein bhi nazar aata hai.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text: (Yeh hamari misaal hai, kitab ki nahin.) Graphical method ko aise samjhiye jaise aap map par do shehron ke beech dariya dhoondte hain. Pehle pata chalta hai ke dariya Lahore aur Gujranwala ke beech kahin hai (yeh LRT ka kaam hai). Phir aap sirf us hisse ka bara naqsha (zoomed map) kholte hain aur dekhte hain ke dariya theek kis jagah se guzarta hai. Naqsha jitna bara, jagah utni theek.

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text: Graphical method ke jawab mein chaar cheezein zaroor dikhaiye: (1) continuity, (2) interval of sign change dono values ke saath, (3) values ki table aur saaf suthra graph jis par crossing ka nishaan ho, (4) graph se parha hua root, zaroori decimal places tak round kiya hua.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Graph paper par graph kaise banayein ke root saaf parha ja sake? Teen mashware:
1. \(x\)-axis par sirf interval of sign change lijiye, maslan 0 se 1, aur usay poore kaghaz ki chaurai par phaila dijiye; har chhota khaana 0.02 ya 0.01 ke barabar ho.
2. \(y\)-axis ka scale table ki sab se chhoti aur sab se bari value dekh kar rakhiye, yahan \(-1\) se \(0.5\) tak.
3. Points ko pencil se halka sa nishaan laga kar smooth haath se joriye; ruler se tukron mein mat joriye.
Is tarah crossing point bara aur saaf nazar aata hai, aur doosra decimal parhna aasaan ho jata hai.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Graphical method se \(f(x) = x^2 - 2\) ka \([1, 2]\) wala root ek decimal tak andaaza lagaiye. Pehle \(f(1.4)\) aur \(f(1.5)\) nikaliye.
Jawab: \(f(1.4) = 1.96 - 2 = -0.04\) aur \(f(1.5) = 2.25 - 2 = 0.25\). Sign 1.4 aur 1.5 ke beech badla, aur \(-0.04\) zero ke bohat qareeb hai, is liye graph axis ko 1.4 ke foran baad kaatega: root \(\approx 1.4\). Asal mein yeh \(\sqrt{2} = 1.4142\ldots\) hai, to hamara andaaza bilkul theek hai. Dekha? Jis number ka root aap jaante hain, us par method aazma kar aap ko is par bharosa ho jata hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Graphical method ki apni hadd (limit) bhi samajh lijiye. Agar do roots bohat qareeb qareeb hon, ya graph \(x\)-axis ko sirf chhoo kar wapas mur jaye (jaise \(y = (x - 1)^2\) \(x = 1\) par), to sign change nazar hi nahin aata aur graph se root parhna mushkil ho jata hai. Aise mauqon par zyada points ke saath graph banana parta hai, ya agle sabaq ke methods istemal karne parte hain. Is chapter ke sawalon mein aam taur par graph axis ko saaf saaf kaatta hai, is liye pareshani nahin hogi.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Graphical method mein \(y = f(x)\) ka graph bana kar dekhte hain ke woh \(x\)-axis ko kahan kaatta hai; wahi root hai.
2. Steps: interval of sign change dhoondo, graph sirf us ke andar banao, crossing parho.
3. Yeh ek ya do decimal places ke liye theek hai aur Bisection, Regula-Falsi aur Newton-Raphson methods ko shuru ki value deta hai.
4. Jab bhi sin, cos ya tan aaye, calculator radian mode mein rakhiye.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. \(\cos x\) ya \(\sin x\) ke liye calculator degree mode mein hona: har value ghalat.
2. Table ki values ko 2 decimals tak round kar dena, phir zero ke qareeb wali value ka sign na dikhna (maslan \(f(0.74) = 0.0015\) round ho kar 0.00 dikhega aur sign gum ho jayega).
3. Poore interval ke kachche (rough) sketch se root parhna. Graph crossing ke qareeb ghaur se aur bara banaiye.
4. Door door ke points ko seedhi tedhi lines se jorna; kaafi points lijiye aur smooth curve banaiye.
